The room features a bed with a curved headboard, a leaf-patterned wallpaper in shades of blue and white, floor-to-ceiling curtains in light gray, abstract artwork on the wall, and a geometric-patterned rug. The space is well-lit with natural light, and the materials used include fabric, paper, polyester, and wood.
